item.text: {"prompt":"A square, edge-to-edge nonrepresentational abstract painting, with no border or surrounding setting. Build a dense, turbulent center from layered ultramarine, bruised violet, rust red, and sharp acid yellow, driven by broken diagonal brushstrokes, scraped pigment, dry-brush grain, and translucent washes. Let these forces press against broad fields of deep charcoal and muted teal, leaving a few abrupt pockets of pale, nearly bare canvas. Use shifts between tightly packed marks and sudden open space to create tension, with irregular rhythms, overlapping textures, and no single focal shape. Make the surface feel physical and unsettled, as if color is gathering, colliding, and dispersing at once. Pure abstraction only: no recognizable objects, figures, scenes, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text."}
